jobs.description:
Support the CEO and executive leadership team by ensuring the smooth coordination of administrative, organizational, marketing, and operational activities.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established organization operating in a dynamic and professional environment, offering a central role with direct exposure to senior management and strategic decision-making.

Description

• Manage the CEO's calendar, meetings, and appointments.
• Coordinate recurring management, board, and shareholder meetings.
• Handle incoming and outgoing communications, including urgent matters.
• Maintain and update key contacts and administrative records.
• Prepare meeting materials and coordinate attendees.
• Support telephone reception and general administrative tasks.
• Assist with marketing activities, including client events, website management, and LinkedIn communications.
• Coordinate facility-related projects and external service providers across offices.

• Experience as an Executive Assistant, Management Assistant, or Office Manager.
• Fluent in Dutch and French, with a good level of English.
• Proactive, autonomous, and highly organized.
• Professional, discreet, and trustworthy.
• Strong communication skills and comfortable working with senior stakeholders.

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem and Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

Are you organized, detail-oriented, and passionate about logistics? Join our team at SAESB as a Logistics Administrator and play a vital role in ensuring the seamless flow of goods across our operations.

Your role:
Are you detail-oriented, well-organized, and interested in logistics processes? We are looking for a Logistics Administrator to manage the entire administrative process for shipping and receiving goods. You will ensure timely deliveries while monitoring compliance with customs regulations.

Your responsibilities:
Administrative support for goods movement:

• Prepare shipping and receiving documents (such as Air Waybills and pro forma invoices).
• Create and follow up on purchase requisitions and orders in the ERP system.
• Ensure accurate and up-to-date data in IT systems.
Transport coordination:

• Schedule and monitor all transport bookings, ensuring accuracy and timely execution.
Customs compliance:

• Verify and ensure adherence to applicable customs laws and regulations.
• Review documents for inbound and outbound shipments.
Reporting:

• Prepare and submit periodic reports on imports and exports.

Your Impact:

• Serve as the first point of contact for daily transport-related queries.
• Ensure timely and complete administrative handling of shipments and related reporting.
• Maintain proper documentation for customs and compliance purposes.

Your profile:

• A higher education degree.
• Solid proficiency in MS Office and ERP systems.
• Practical knowledge of ADR regulations, customs laws, and Incoterms (or willingness to follow training).
• Understanding of logistics operations, including both road and air freight.
• A structured and precise approach, consistently following established procedures.
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize in a dynamic environment.
• A proactive, problem-solving mindset, able to anticipate and prevent issues.
• Flexibility to manage shifting priorities efficiently.
• Able to work independently after a six-month training period.
• Proficiency in Dutch, French, and English, sufficient for both internal communication and contacts with external suppliers.

jobs.occupation: Legal Counsel - International clients - Flemish Brabant
jobs.description:

Combining legal expertise, wealth structuring coordination, contract advisory, estate planning support, tax coordination, and day-to-day administrative assistance, the firm delivers a unique and highly personalized service to a portfolio of more than 100 clients across Belgium and internationally.

• Review, draft, and coordinate contractual documentation.
• Support matters relating to estate planning, wealth structuring, insurance, and family law.
• Coordinate real estate transactions, including purchase agreements, leases, and notarial processes.
• Liaise with external advisors including notaries, tax experts, accountants, and legal counsel.
• Provide practical support regarding social security, invoicing, and administrative matters.
• Organize and structure client files while ensuring excellent follow-up.
• Monitor deadlines, legal documentation, and ongoing projects.
• Deliver pragmatic and solutions-oriented legal guidance.
• Communicate legal concepts in a simple and accessible manner.

A successful Legal Counsel should have:

• Belgian Master's degree in Law 
• Legal professional as from 3 years of experience are welcome to apply.
• Strong analytical skills and legal reasoning.
• Excellent organizational and planning abilities.
• Detail-oriented, critical thinker, and committed to delivering high-quality work.
• Fluent in Dutch & English
• Proactive and hands-on personality.
• Mature enough to work autonomously while knowing when to seek guidance.
• Genuine willingness to learn and develop.
• Comfortable working in an environment where responsibility comes early.

The company is looking for a commercially driven professional who enjoys approaching potential customers, developing new accounts and turning opportunities into actual sales.

• Actively identify and approach potential B2B customers across the Middle East and Africa. 
• Prospect for new business opportunities and open new customer accounts.

• Build relationships with new customers and develop long-term business opportunities. 
• Maintain and expand existing customer accounts. 
• Identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling. 
• Prepare quotations and follow up on commercial proposals. 
• Process orders and respond to customer enquiries. 
• Maintain regular contact with customers by telephone and email.

• You have a commercial and/or technical background. 
• You have experience in B2B sales and/or customer service.

• You are confident initiating commercial conversations and following up on opportunities. 
• You are fluent in English and French, both written and spoken. 
• Knowledge of Arabic is an advantage, but not a requirement.

• You take initiative and are motivated by commercial results. 
• You can work independently while maintaining close contact with your sales colleagues.
